description_text: DSS/ITS is requesting the following:1) REQ0236489/REQ0230541/SO0001216: DHS/ITS is requesting the purchase of Microsoft Surface Pro for Business along with the Microsoft Surface Pro Keyboard with Trackpad and Surface Slim Pen 2 through Grant Funding. 2)REQ0244428/SO0001255: DSS/ITS is requesting the purchase of TC10 Touch Controller (Black), a Studio A2 Wired Microphone for the Meeting Room, and a Studio X72 All-In-One Video Bar. 3)REQ0235651/SO0001223: DSS/ITS is requesting the purchase of Microsoft Surface Pro 11 Copilot+ PC Tablet - 13 along with the Microsoft Surface Pro KBw/Slim Pen. This purchase is for the Commissioner's office new hires/senior staff. 4) REQ0240522/SO0001234: DHS/ITS is requesting the purchase of an Apple 16' MacBook Pro (M5 Pro, Silver) for the DHS Administrators Office.5) REQ0241171/SO0001252: DSS/ITS on behalf of the eDevelopment team is requesting the purchase of the Mac Mini 6, AppleCare, Logitech Core PRO X Gaming Headset Pro, and G-RAID/drive storage devices as it is essential for the eDevelopers responsible for producing video-based training that supports DHS, DSS, and HRA software implementations.
